review_text: Recent updates have introduced a bunch of bugs that make it really inconvenient to use daily. The grid view has random large or elongated photos making it hard to scan photos and follow their chronological order. The edit tools randomly switch order, making it take longer to find specific tools. Select and drag is completely bugged, making it tedious to select more than one photo. Really disappointing, as this was one of the most polished Google apps but is now buggy and a chore to use.
evidence_quote: The grid view has random large or elongated photos making it hard to scan photos

review_text: After a decade, I'm having to shop around for an alternate gallery/editing app. UI navigation is so much worse than ever before. Features are harder to find--the opposite of intuitive. Generative AI is fun, but it is not a replacement for editing an original photo, yet basic editing features are harder to access and tell when they are applied. And SO buggy. Random changes do not apply if they're not done before certain other changes. I'm sick of being an involuntary beta tester, Google.
evidence_quote: UI navigation is so much worse than ever before

review_text: the app now force you to select a picture of yourself before you can search in photos. it will pop up and nag everytime you try to search for something if you don't. it is truly annoying and unnecessary.
evidence_quote: the app now force you to select a picture of yourself before you can search in photos

review_text: Once loved this for photo storing and basic manipulation, but the updates are terrible for any kind of photo editing. Cropping now showing curved corners instead of straight, pushy AI, and the inability to work in landscape mode are all huge downgrades. Update July 2026- now even browsing your pictures, the UI is covered with needless floating menus and mismatched image sizes making it hard to find pictures. 50% of my images are covered with black bubbles while scrolling
evidence_quote: the UI is covered with needless floating menus and mismatched image sizes

review_text: Overall, it's good. The only thing I don't like is that there should be an option to detect or find duplicate photos, because sometimes it contains a lot of duplicate photos. Adding this feature would make it much easier to organize and clean up the gallery.
evidence_quote: there should be an option to detect or find duplicate photos

review_text: Google Photos is simply the best photo management app I've ever used. The backup is fast and reliable, the search is incredibly accurate, and the AI-powered features make organizing memories effortless. I love how easy it is to find old photos, free up storage, and keep everything securely synced across devices. The interface is clean, smooth, and user-friendly. A truly world-class app that keeps getting better with every update. Highly recommended!

This app has become completely unusable after recent updates. The battery drain is insane—my phone gets hot and loses percentage rapidly even when I am barely browsing my photos. On top of that, the performance is terrible. Animations are choppy, laggy, and frame-dropping constantly, making basic scrolling feel frustratingly slow. To make matters worse, the whole user interface is a cluttered mess—finding simple local device folders or settings has become overly complex and confusing.
evidence_quote: finding simple local device folders or settings has become overly complex

review_text: Its ok but will love two more things to be done, 1st is the 'select all' option when you have photos in your Album and then option to locate your backup photos
evidence_quote: option to locate your backup photos

review_text: My Google photos updated last night and did an auto back up and now all my new photos are not showing up, I did find them and it's saving them to a hidden folder in my phone but it's now letting me view them.
evidence_quote: now all my new photos are not showing up

review_text: Google Photos is remarkably smooth, but it still lacks essential local management tools. Please add an in-album search button to find specific filenames, persistent scroll memory so albums do not reset to the top, and continuous multi-photo selection without interruption. We also need direct on-device folder creation, customisable album column density, and a fast-scroll scrubber like Samsung Gallery. It would elevate the app completely.
evidence_quote: add an in-album search button to find specific filenames
